changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.7.4:

• 🔊 Smooth Audio & Zero Voice Breaking: Fixed audio stuttering and chopping after long background idle periods by eliminating inter-chunk pauses and deploying dynamic AudioFocus management with ducking.

• 🛡️ 1-Second Headroom & Jitter Cushion: Upgraded playback buffer to 48KB (1 full second) with a 4.8KB pre-buffering cushion, completely preventing DAC buffer underruns from network delays.

• 🎙️ Audio Hardware Re-sync: Added automatic AudioRecord re-alignment on wake from background standby to ensure seamless speech capture.
